author: AtditC
body: Are the seniors working on them right now or did they somehow get lost? I remember where they said Interviews would start on the 1st of September and now already 3 weeks passed. I'm just asking what happened to them, not how long it will take until they're all reviewed. Also I think you can still post threads under the section "Staff Applications".

title: Staff Applications?

replies.author: rinn
replies.body: Yeah, we didn't forget about them and we're not going to auto-deny anyone, but they did get lost in the clutter of all the applications. We've reorganized and set a deadline for ourselves to get them done really soon, though. I think funky didn't lock the application sub-forum yet so we can reply to the remaining applications.
